title.from: Type VideoJob — production job; VideoML renders; Babulus owns the job
title.to: NOTE not a type — Video render status lives on Deliverable (was VideoJob)

description.from:
Parked type spec — do not implement. Not in progress. File stays on Babulus (not a VideoML code change).

## Type: VideoJob

Production of an Asset (Video deliverable) or Slot creative. Chattic bots claim by state. **VideoML renders; Babulus owns the job.** VideoML is the renderer, not the publicity calendar.

## States

`brief` → `script` → `render` → `preview` → `approved` → `published` | `killed`

Ryan approval applies before anything is queued or posted from the resulting asset.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> brief
  brief --> script
  script --> render
  render --> preview
  preview --> approved
  approved --> published
  approved --> killed
  preview --> killed
  published --> [*]
  killed --> [*]
```

## Out of scope

- No VideoML calendar
- No auto-publish to social
- No implementation from this issue
description.to:
**Not an issue type.** Closed as a note. Publicist accepted 2026-09-01 campaign-ops list.

VideoJob is dropped. Render status lives on **Deliverable `kind=Video`**. VideoML is still the renderer. **Publicist should not see jobs.**

Do not re-open as a Kanbus type. Do not put a job queue on the Publicist board.
